name: exists_reduceAt_mul_incl_eq
summary: Extend each Y_i, and each inclusion matrix at the twist places, to an invertible matrix; then lift the family of residues to K₀.

steps.claim: For each chosen place choose A_i invertible with A_i·I_incl = Y_i (exists_GL_mul_inclMatrix: a matrix with independent columns extends to an invertible one).
steps.lean: choose A a using (exists_GL_mul_inclMatrix O.incl <| hY ·)

steps.claim: For each twist place choose B_j invertible with B_j·I_e = I_incl (the inclusion matrix has independent columns).
steps.lean:
choose B b using (exists_GL_mul_inclMatrix e <| inclMatrix_mulVecLin_injective O.incl <|
    ResField <| O.twistPlace ·)

steps.claim: Take k ∈ K₀ supported on the places of O whose reductions are A_i at the chosen places and B_jᵀ at the twist places (exists_reduceFamily_eq).
Unfold the reductions: the three conditions hold (simp, tauto).
